maria: Heads-up — thinking about adding a 'config entropy' warning in Console when a change would create a large number of new routing permutations. Example: enabling per-customer route-by-cost combined with per-model quantization flags can explode routes.
jamal: oof yeah that's bitten us before. what's the trigger? number of new permutations or estimated QPS per new bucket? :thinking_face:
priya: telemetry cost is the other axis. more routes -> more metrics cardinality -> higher retention costs. we should estimate both cardinality delta and token delta.
kevin: +1. propose a small heuristic: if change increases route permutations by >50x OR increases expected unique series by >500, surface a soft warning. hard block at >5000 series.
maria: that seems reasonable as a starting point. also want UI suggestions: preview panel that shows affected services, sample cohorts, and estimated telemetry cost delta.
liz: can we show a dry-run sample? e.g., run the change against a week of trace data to show how many unique traces would be created. maybe flag as "audit required" if it touches sensitive cohorts.
priya: sample CLI output mock:
```
$ redwood config preview --flag route_by_cost --scope customer:cohortA --dry-run
preview: 4,384 affected routes (est. metric series +1,024)
telemetry cost change: +$18/month (30d retention)
recommended action: enable shadow routing for 1% traffic, collect evals
```
jamal: love the dry-run. also add SLO-aware defaults — if new routing could increase tail latency risk, console should suggest enabling a lower-sample shadow first.
sanjay: how do we compute latency risk? we can look at historical per-route 95/99 percentiles and correlate added routing weight. cheap approximation: if the target backends currently sit above 70th percentile CPU or have high queue depth, mark as risky.
kevin: we already ship per-model perf profiles in model catalog. tie that to preview: show estimated P99 token latency delta for affected models.
opsbot: FYI runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/config-entropy (internal) — includes rollback steps and safe shadow commands.
deploy-bot: staging preview service for config dry-run deployed to staging-rc. Use `preview-service.staging.redwood` for now. :rocket:
maria: question on approval flow — if warning is soft we still want quick rollout for small ops. but if hard threshold hit (kevin's >5000) require two owners + security signoff for scope change. thoughts?
liz: agree. also add an audit field on the change so approvers can record rationale and expected time window. helps postmortems.
priya: telemetry sampling changes need a different flow — if you're increasing sampling (higher cardinality) we should automatically suggest a cost offset action (e.g., reduce retention from 30->14 days) or require product approval.
jamal: UX nit: don't spam with warnings for tiny edits. only show if estimated impact > a small absolute floor (like >20 new series).
sanjay: also add a quick 'simulate for 1% traffic' option that auto-generates a canary route and a TTLed override. makes safe testing easy.
kevin: implementation notes: preview service needs access to archived traces + the model perf catalog + current routing matrix. compute should be offline 5-10s per preview. cache previews per change hash.
maria: action items: 1) draft short RFC for 'config entropy' UI + thresholds (jamal + maria) 2) telemetry estimate algorithm prototype (priya + kevin) 3) dry-run integration with preview service (sanjay + liz) 4) add audit + approval gating (ops)
jamal: I'll start the RFC skeleton tonight.
priya: I'll throw together a quick notebook to estimate metric-series delta tomorrow.
sanjay: will add a preview endpoint stub this week.
kevin: I'll expose P99 delta in the model catalog API.
maria: thanks folks. let's aim to have a short demo at next eng-platform sync. :thumbsup:
liz: ping me for UI mock reviews once RFC lands.
opsbot: reminder: if any change touches customer-sensitive route keys, add `requires-security-approval=true` tag.
deploy-bot: deployed telemetry-estimator prototype to feature/dev. link: https://staging.internal/redwood/telemetry-estimator :eyes:
jamal: sweet. meeting to align next Tue?
maria: yes — Tue 10am. I'll add to the calendar and attach the RFC draft when ready.
kevin: one more thought — expose an API so infra teams can run these previews as part of CI for config PRs.
priya: +1. prevents surprises in automation.
maria: cool, closing here. filing ticket for RFC and linking runbook. thanks! :wave:
